AccountEpoch.description: Unique identifier for one authenticated account session epoch.

AccountHandoffGoal.description: The account change a client asks the user to make in the player.

oneOf.description: The account already satisfies the goal; nothing was asked of the user.
Shown in the player's activity view; the user signs in there. No window is opened.
The requested account change was observed in the player.

AccountScope.description: Redacted local scope identifier isolating accounts in cache/state.

uiLanguage.description: Settings saved before the UI language existed load as English.

audioMode.description: Song or video variant selected in the official page.

qualityLabel.description: Opaque playback-quality label reported by the page, not a measured audio bit rate.

BridgeEpoch.description: Unique identifier for one authorized page bridge handshake.

BrowseId.description: Opaque YouTube Music browse endpoint identifier.

ControlRequest.description: Application protocol over the local control socket.

oneOf.description: Returns the next prompt for a DJ agent, if any; polled by the MCP adapter while it waits.

CoreEpoch.description: Unique identifier for one Rust core process instance.

DjChattiness.description: How often the heartbeat lets the agent check in with the listener.

DjCue.description: One prompt for the agent, with the listening context as it is at delivery.

preferences.description:
The recorded tastes, sent on this client's first prompt and whenever they changed since
its previous one; empty when `preferences_unchanged`.

preferencesUnchanged.description: The tastes are the same as in this client's previous prompt.

spoke.description: The agent said something to the listener since its previous call.

userSpoke.description: The listener talked to the agent since its previous call.

oneOf.description: The current track is about to end.
A good moment to ask the listener whether the music still suits them.
The listener has not done or said anything for a while.
The current track is long.
Nothing in particular; it has simply been a while.
At most one track is queued after the current one.
Kept for the account until cleared; replaces an earlier entry for the same subject.

DjFeedbackTarget.description: What a feedback entry is about.

oneOf.description: A command from the player window, media keys or MPRIS.
The agent reported that the listener talked to it.

lastSpokenToAgoMs.description: When the agent last reported speaking to the listener.

unansweredCheckIns.description:
Unanswered check-ins in a row: each check-in that comes with no listener action or words
since the previous check-in adds one, and any listener action or words reset it. The
first check-in after a reset counts 0. Above zero, check-ins come less often.

DjPreference.description: One recorded DJ preference of the current account.

recordedBy.description: The registered client that recorded it; not a claim about a human.

DjTrack.description: The few track facts a DJ prompt needs; the music tools return the full track.

oneOf.description: Ended early without a command the player could attribute.

InterruptResumePolicy.description: What follows an immediate interruption once the inserted tracks have played.

oneOf.description: Replay the interrupted track from its saved position, then the original upcoming queue.
Continue with the original upcoming queue; the interrupted track is not replayed.
Start a new playback context from the inserted tracks; nothing is restored.
The policy does not restore anything.
The inserted tracks are playing; the interrupted track has not been resumed yet.
The replay occurrence started and the saved position was observed.
Manual control, a divergent queue, cancellation, expiry or a restart ended the plan.

LocalHistoryRange.description: The local recording timestamp is known. YouTube history may only have a period label.

removed.description: What a removal took away, recorded before anything is sent, so it can be restored.

oneOf.description: A request for the user to sign in, renew or switch the account in the player.
Saved resume plan of an immediate interruption, updated as playback progresses.

resumeEntryId.description: The queued replay occurrence of the interrupted track, once it is verified.

resumePositionMs.description: Playback position captured right before the switch, when the policy resumes it.

PlaybackContext.description: Playlist identity and index read from the official page's selected native queue item.

QueueEntryId.description: Occurrence-scoped queue entry identifier within a bridge epoch.

RemovedItem.description: One entry a removal took (or, while unsettled, may have taken) from the account or device.

oneOf.description: A playlist occurrence and its zero-based position in the playlist before the removal.
A local playback history entry and when it was recorded.

ShareAccess.description: Access evidence for an individual recipient remains unknown.

TrackInstanceId.description: Unique playback instance identifier (distinguishes repeated plays).

UiLanguage.description: The language the UI is shown in. Values are the UI's BCP 47 locale tags.

oneOf.description: Remove the nearest loaded upcoming occurrences, at most 50; partial when more may follow.
Clear the upcoming occurrences best effort, then insert in input order.
Switch to the inserted tracks now and follow the explicit resume policy afterwards.
A struct variant: the edit carries its own `kind` tag inside `edit`.
Asks the user, without opening or focusing any window, to change the account.
